location.name: The Hive Leisure Centre
location.description: Welcome to The Hive Leisure Centre. The Centre boasts a modern and spacious gym with dedicated cardio, strength, resistance and functional zones, complete with almost 100 pieces of state-of-the-art Technogym equipment. Two air-conditioned fitness studios offer a variety of fitness classes. The Hive is also home to two swimming pools; a 25m-long main pool and a teaching pool with a moveable floor that host a range of activities. The Hive also offers an array of activities for children, including soft play, birthday parties, junior gym, and holiday activities. A spacious sports hall is available for hire to sports clubs and recreational badminton sessions. The Café serves hot and cold drinks and snacks with a seating area.

data.name: Gym
data.description: Regular exercise benefits your health, mind and body. Gym workouts boost your energy, increase lean muscle mass, decrease your risk for certain health conditions and help you manage your weight, but it also improves your mood and enables you to live longer.

location.name: Gunnersbury Park Sports Hub
location.description: The complex boasts a large, airy gym on the first floor, overlooking the park, and provides state-of-the-art Life Fitness equipment across the dedicated cardio, strength, resistance and functional areas, with both adult and junior memberships available.  Our two fitness studios offer a variety of classes, from Yoga to HIIT to Group Cycle; as well as virtual Aerobics and Group Cycle classes, so you can work out even when timetabled classes aren’t running.  The large sports hall offers facilities for badminton, handball, futsal, basketball, netball and volleyball for competition-level players as well as customers of all ages and abilities, throughout the week.  Available to hire outdoors are 8 floodlit tennis courts, 2 full-size all-weather football pitches, 9 adult and junior grass football pitches, a rugby pitch and 3 grass cricket wickets.

location.name: Forest Hill Pools
location.description: This centre has a 35 station gym offering fitness zones for cardio, strength and resistance training, or enjoy a group workout in one of our studios offering classes such as HIIT and Zumba. Spin in our brand new Group Cycle zone, and then wind down in a Yoga class. And if you’re a swimmer we have a six-lane, 25m pool that suits both fitness and recreational needs and hosts our popular Water Workout classes. The learner pool offers fun for all the family and is home to our swimming lessons. You can also hire our meeting room and relax in our Café, which follows the Healthier Catering Commitment scheme.

location.name: Queensmead Sports Centre
location.description: The 90 station, two floor, air-conditioned provides a range of cardio and strengthe equipment plus stretching area, with the fitness studio offering a variety of weekly classes including; ranginf from yoga to extreme interval fitness sessions. Our multi purpose sports hall is well equipped for activities including badminton, football, basketball and handball. The floodlit tennis and netball courts are available for hire, with a tennis programme available during the summer months. Queensmead provides a wide range of activities for all the family as well as coached tennis sessions and courses, junior activities and children's birthday parties.
